description: Full PWA support for all screens (PART 3, MEDIUM). Add a web app manifest, a generated icon set (192, 512, maskable 512, apple-touch 180) derived from a new crisp melon SVG (NOT public/assets/icon.svg, which must be left alone), a conservative service worker, and wire everything into app/layout.tsx following the existing app-router metadata pattern, including viewport-fit=cover for safe areas and a dark-green theme-color. Independent of FEAT-001 and FEAT-002; ordered last because it is MEDIUM priority.
steps: Create public/icon-source.svg: a crisp vector melon/brand icon on the app's dark palette (background #020706, mint accent #79ffd0), square viewBox (e.g. 0 0 512 512), with the melon motif centered. Do NOT use or modify public/assets/icon.svg (it is absent/untracked and off-limits).

Create scripts/generate-pwa-icons.mjs: a one-time Node ESM script (document in a header comment that it is a manual generator, not part of the build) that uses sharp (require/import 'sharp' from node_modules) to rasterize public/icon-source.svg into: public/icon-192.png (192x192), public/icon-512.png (512x512), public/icon-maskable-512.png (512x512 rendered with ~20% safe-zone padding and an opaque #020706 background for purpose:maskable), and public/apple-touch-icon.png (180x180, opaque background). Run `node scripts/generate-pwa-icons.mjs` to produce the four PNGs.

Create public/manifest.webmanifest (valid JSON): name 'MahaMelon — Melon Supply Intelligence', short_name 'MahaMelon', description matching the app, start_url '/', scope '/', display 'standalone', orientation 'any', background_color '#020706', theme_color '#020706', and icons array with /icon-192.png (192x192, image/png, purpose 'any'), /icon-512.png (512x512, image/png, 'any'), and /icon-maskable-512.png (512x512, image/png, 'maskable').

Create public/sw.js: dependency-free vanilla service worker. On install, pre-cache a minimal app shell (['/','/manifest.webmanifest','/favicon.svg','/icon-192.png','/icon-512.png','/icon-maskable-512.png','/apple-touch-icon.png']) under a versioned cache name (e.g. mahamelon-v1); skipWaiting. On activate, delete old caches and clients.claim(). On fetch: ignore non-GET and cross-origin requests (YouTube, nexus.sisda.my, quickchart, gamesv2.sisda.my, pantauharga.vercel.app) by not calling respondWith; for same-origin navigation/document requests use network-first with fallback to cached '/'; for other same-origin static assets use cache-first with network fallback and runtime caching.

Wire PWA into app/layout.tsx following the existing metadata export pattern: add `manifest: '/manifest.webmanifest'` to the metadata object; add an `appleWebApp: { capable: true, statusBarStyle: 'black-translucent', title: 'MahaMelon' }`; extend `icons` to include `apple: '/apple-touch-icon.png'` alongside the existing favicon entries. Add a `export const viewport: Viewport = { themeColor: '#020706', width: 'device-width', initialScale: 1, viewportFit: 'cover' }` (import Viewport from 'next') to set theme-color and viewport-fit=cover. Do NOT remove the GLB <link rel=preload> or the sisda <Script> widget.

Create app/sw-register.tsx: a 'use client' component that in a useEffect (guarded by typeof window !== 'undefined' && 'serviceWorker' in navigator) registers '/sw.js' on window load; render nothing (returns null). Import and render <SwRegister /> inside <body> in app/layout.tsx next to the existing <Script>.
acceptance_criteria: `node scripts/generate-pwa-icons.mjs` exits 0 and public/icon-192.png, icon-512.png, icon-maskable-512.png, apple-touch-icon.png exist with correct dimensions (512x512 for the 512s, 192x192, 180x180).
public/manifest.webmanifest is valid JSON (parses without error) and lists name, short_name, start_url, display:standalone, theme_color, and the three icons including the maskable one.
`npm run build` exits 0 and `npm test` passes both subtests; `npm run lint` exits 0.

In `npm run dev`, DevTools > Application > Manifest shows the name, icons, and theme color with no errors and reports the app as installable; the service worker registers and activates; the apple-touch-icon and maskable icon resolve.
Cross-origin resources (YouTube, sisda widget, quickchart QR, external iframes) are not intercepted/broken by the service worker.
verification: npm run dev then verify in browser DevTools Application tab: manifest valid + installable, service worker active, icons resolve, and external iframes/widget still load
findings: New files: public/icon-source.svg (square 512x512 melon on #020706/#79ffd0 palette, leaf accent, rind netting); scripts/generate-pwa-icons.mjs (manual ESM sharp generator, NOT wired into build; run `node scripts/generate-pwa-icons.mjs`); public/manifest.webmanifest; public/sw.js (cache name 'mahamelon-v1', shell = ['/','/manifest.webmanifest','/favicon.svg','/icon-192.png','/icon-512.png','/icon-maskable-512.png','/apple-touch-icon.png'], network-first for navigations/document requests, cache-first for other same-origin GET assets, cross-origin + non-GET left untouched via early return); app/sw-register.tsx ('use client' SwRegister, registers /sw.js on window load, returns null). Generated + committed PNGs: public/icon-192.png (192x192 transparent), icon-512.png (512x512 transparent), icon-maskable-512.png (512x512 opaque #020706 with 20% safe-zone padding), apple-touch-icon.png (180x180 opaque #020706). app/layout.tsx: imported Viewport type from 'next' and SwRegister from './sw-register'; added manifest:'/manifest.webmanifest', appleWebApp {capable,statusBarStyle:'black-translucent',title:'MahaMelon'}, icons.apple:'/apple-touch-icon.png'; added `export const viewport: Viewport = { themeColor:'#020706', width:'device-width', initialScale:1, viewportFit:'cover' }`; rendered <SwRegister/> inside <body> before the sisda <Script>; GLB preload and sisda widget left intact. Verification: node generator exits 0 with correct dimensions, manifest parses, `npm run build` green, `npm test` both subtests pass (FEAT-001's 07->08 fix already committed on this branch at 7cc6aba/583f935), my files lint clean (`npx eslint app/layout.tsx app/sw-register.tsx scripts/generate-pwa-icons.mjs` exits 0). DEVIATION / PRE-EXISTING ISSUE: `npm run lint` exits 1 with 3 errors + 5 warnings, ALL react-hooks/set-state-in-effect in app/scene-three-analytics.tsx and app/page.tsx. These exist verbatim in committed HEAD (confirmed via git stash of my layout change) and are owned by FEAT-001/FEAT-002 (which touch page.tsx), NOT introduced by FEAT-003. Left untouched to stay within feature scope; a later pass owning those files must resolve them to make `npm run lint` fully clean.
